features: 【ALL-DAY HEART RATE MONITORING】 Designed to monitor your heart rate throughout the day, this smart fitness band helps you stay informed about your activity levels during walking, running, workouts and everyday routines. The easy-to-read display lets you check your heart rate quickly, making it simple to understand your daily fitness progress and maintain a more active lifestyle.

【DAILY ACTIVITY & FITNESS TRACKING】 Track important daily fitness data including step count, walking distance, calorie information and activity progress to help maintain healthy habits. Whether you're exercising, commuting, walking outdoors or staying active at work, the fitness tracker provides useful insights that help you stay motivated and work toward your personal wellness goals.

【OLED TOUCH DISPLAY & SMART NOTIFICATIONS】 The bright OLED touchscreen offers clear visibility for fitness information, while Bluetooth connectivity allows compatible smartphones to display call alerts, message notifications, calendar reminders and supported app notifications directly on your wrist. Quickly view important updates without constantly checking your phone during meetings, workouts or travel.

【WATERPROOF & COMFORTABLE FOR EVERYDAY USE】 Built with a lightweight strap and waterproof design, this activity tracker is comfortable to wear throughout the day during office work, exercise sessions, walking, cycling and other daily activities. The secure adjustable strap provides a comfortable fit for extended wear while supporting an active lifestyle.

【SLEEP MONITORING & LONG-LASTING PERFORMANCE】 Monitor your sleep patterns alongside your daily activity information to better understand your routine and build healthier habits. The rechargeable smart band combines practical fitness tracking, Bluetooth connectivity, lightweight comfort and everyday convenience, making it suitable for students, professionals and fitness enthusiasts alike.
